title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Run multiple financial reports and get a single PDF output (Combines multiple Financial Reports into a single PDF)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces Financial Report Packages, a feature that combines multiple financial reports into a single PDF that can be printed immediately or scheduled for email delivery. This replaces the previous workflow of running and configuring multiple reports separately.
key_points: Financial Report Packages consolidate multiple financial reports into one PDF document
You can apply distinct filters and date formulas to each report within a package
Reports can be printed immediately or scheduled for regular email delivery to multiple recipients
The feature eliminates the need to set up and run separate reports individually

quotes.text: Financial Report Packages combines multiple Financial Reports into a single PDF, which can be exported or emailed on a regular basis.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability introduced in this wave, showing the main benefit of the new feature.

quotes.text: You can apply distinct filtering criteria to each combined report.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the flexibility of the feature, allowing different filters for different reports in the same package.

quotes.text: For a single Financial Report Package, you can set multiple schedules.
quotes.why_it_matters: This shows that packages support complex scheduling scenarios with multiple recurring email deliveries.
